validationNotes: Actual nameKey9385→9389; clean baseline322882d7, no prior running work/tests. All9385 original definitions, IDs, catalogue/details/aliases, old image URLs and pins unchanged. Six full official original/reprint images/mana/current restrictions verified; two reprints add no names.

Four complete S Trigger X gears use existing trigger declaration and mandatory required927 cross selection. Generation with no own creature succeeds; with own creatures it must cross with no decline. Paid generation, declining trigger, ordinary paid recross and own-field-only/actual sealed-host rules verified for both players. Exact QA43456/37489/37492 reproduced.

Kagayaki full native entry and crossed-host attack tap-freeze plus exact QA43760: Command gear generation unseals actual Musashi Niten before mandatory cross selection. Common Command check corrected from creatures only to actual Command elements. Existing Taisho gear now also unseals without redefining any old card. Actual Sirius draw watcher waits until cross finishes and draws once.

Acterion attack-only9000 and granted T stack while ignored host loses them. Existing W/T/quad/world choices retained, no plain single-break alternative added. Inferno mandatory trigger optionally selects distinct opponents with current-power total<=3000, no over-budget extra; ignored host still triggers, ignored gear does not. Maximum external5000 plus granted Blocker and noAttack verified, including actual next-attack blocking.

Exact QA44661 actual Complex with7 sources frozen by Kagayaki still untaps through its triggered eighth source at next start. Normal tap-freeze lasts exactly the next natural untap and expires afterward. JSON/encrypted STX and original legal40/80-card seeded completion pass.

58 unique focused cases pass, including first50 with no failures;369 affected regressions pass,total427. Check21.038s,audit12.033s,actual nameKey/invariants/target9500 pass. Online/save and check were accidentally queued twice after the interrupted shell continued; only latest identical execution counts, no duplicate test totals.

Positive selection accidentally retained two screenshot multi-game cases from kenji-photo; stopped only newly launched process group18102 at85.758s. No broad result is a pass. Corrected positive list excludes those2 and all62 required short Redzone/Complex cases pass independently. Neither broad screenshot group will be restarted; exact unconfirmed targets recorded below and in resume pending.
